## Overview

Use this page as the short path for assembling and running an ETF exam.

## Typical workflow

- Confirm the exam scope and timing.
- Gather the PrairieLearn content that will appear on the exam.
- Assemble the exam package and test it end to end.
- Coordinate launch, monitoring, and follow-up.
